MSP.Settings.Enabled.Name: Mobile mode (this browser only)
MSP.Settings.Enabled.Hint: Turns on the phone interface. The choice applies only to this browser on this device — it changes nothing for the GM or other players. You can also turn it off from the More button inside mobile mode.
MSP.Settings.Skills.Name: Skills on the rail
MSP.Settings.Skills.Hint: Comma-separated names of the skills shown on the side rail. Leave blank to use the common ones automatically (the five SWADE core skills plus Fighting and Shooting). Weapons and items do not need to be listed here: just mark them as favourites on the sheet.
MSP.Rail.Label: Actions
MSP.Bar.Label: Navigation
MSP.Target.Label: Target
MSP.Target.Title: Target
MSP.More.Label: More
MSP.Prompt.Detected: This device looks like a phone or a tablet.
MSP.Prompt.Question: Turn on mobile mode in this browser? It applies here only — it changes nothing for the other players, and you can turn it off at any time from the More button.
MSP.Log.Both: Log saved to your downloads and copied to the clipboard.
MSP.Log.Failed: Could not save the log automatically. It was printed to the console instead.
MSP.Settings.Capture.Name: Capture console messages
MSP.Settings.Capture.Hint: Records warnings and errors so that More -> Save diagnostic log has something to write. Off by default: while it is on, the browser's developer tools report every warning in the game as coming from this module, which makes other modules harder to debug. Turn it on just before reproducing a problem.
